page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance based on KVM virtualization. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the processor provides 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. It incorporates vector instruction extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside hardware acceleration for AES cryptography, BMI2, and FMA.

The instance is provisioned with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs included. The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for all operational and persistence requirements. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.c5.4xlarge in the middle tier for multi-threaded compute and throughput tasks, contrasted with weaker single-thread metrics. In single-core evaluations, the instance produced a Geekbench score of 1025.0 and a stress-ng score of 1107.09, both ranking in the lower 25 percent. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks show balanced capability, scoring 6333.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 13076.83 in PassMark CPU tests. Memory read throughput reaches 61.39 GB/sec on uncached large blocks, and Redis SET throughput achieves 11.41 million operations per second.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance trades single-threaded peak velocity and local disk IOPS for balanced multi-core density. Without integrated NVMe storage or high per-core burst clocks, it delivers predictable mid-range parallel processing capacity. Suitable workloads include distributed compile pipelines, multi-threaded batch data transformations, static web serving clusters, and containerized microservices that depend on external persistent storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor. Provisioned with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 32.0 GB of memory, it operates on a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The architecture includes AVX-512 vector support and 35 MB of L3 cache, but includes no local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, operating alongside a 5 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate modest single-thread speed balanced by solid multi-threaded performance, as demonstrated by a PassMark CPU score of 13076.83, a Clang compilation score of 10468.0, and 11.41 million Redis SET operations per second. Lacking bundled storage and exceptional single-core clock frequencies, the ecs.c5.4xlarge is engineered for parallelized CPU workloads such as multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation, static web serving, and containerized microservice backends utilizing remote cloud storage.
